name: RUPTURE Dam V3 - Water Over Road
behaviour: On first note: open. Held notes: loop frames 11-13, octave-controlled interval. Final note-off: close. After closing, display idle frame 01.
road: Flood and foam overlap the dashed roadway. Markings remain outside submerged areas; visible markings are partially obscured inside the water.
sources: Corrected illustrated reference. Frames 15-16 are deterministic intermediate transitions (not present as numbered cells in the reference).
note: Assets only. RUPTURE firmware and WebInstaller are not modified.
